dm.summary: I loaded the beta site at 1440x900 and created the account lightkeeper_rue_r3 through the Enlist with the Chapter form. The account was created (the API calls go to user id 33), but I can't stay signed in. After sign-up, and after each manual sign-in, POST /api/auth/login returns 200. The very next authenticated calls (GET /api/users/33/characters and /api/users/33/campaigns) return 401, and the app quietly logs out and shows an empty sign-in form. A network trace shows where the 401s come from: the response header x-proxy-error reads "upstream auth failed: connection \"CANDELA_BETA\", rule \"*.gatergrid.com\"". This is the sandbox's egress proxy, which supplies the beta site password. It fails any request that already carries the app's own Authorization: Bearer header. The CANDELA_BETA_USER/PASS environment variables are not set, so lib.js does not use httpCredentials. I waited 60 seconds and tried once more, with the same result. So "The Saltmere Chapter" was not created, there is no campaign code, and I could not look at the Lightkeeper desk. Every AI seat will probably hit the same wall. I logged F001: on any 401 the site drops you on a blank sign-in form with no message, so a new user can't tell whether their account was made. I also logged F002: the Google sign-in frame has no accessible name, and it still says "Sign in with Google" on the sign-up screen. Instead of the welcome line, I told the table in character that the code will come later. My memory file is updated.
dm.blocked: I can't stay signed in on beta from this sandbox. The account lightkeeper_rue_r3 exists, but every request that carries the app's own Authorization: Bearer token gets a 401 from the sandbox's egress proxy, with x-proxy-error "upstream auth failed: connection CANDELA_BETA, rule *.gatergrid.com". The proxy supplies the beta site password and fails requests that already have their own Authorization header. A retry after 60 seconds failed the same way. Because of this, the campaign, the code and the look round the desk are not done. To fix it, either give the seats the site password another way (set CANDELA_BETA_USER/CANDELA_BETA_PASS so lib.js uses Playwright's httpCredentials) or stop the CANDELA_BETA proxy connection from failing requests that carry their own Authorization header. Then restart the seats with start_all.sh.
